newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLOs seen supported by 1997 budget.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLOs seen supported by 1997 budget.

text.p: Belgian bonds are expected to get support from the government's budget statement Tuesday, in which Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene should confirm his target of cutting the 1997 deficit to 2.9 percent of GDP.
OLOs' yield premium over Bunds ended at a new closing low of 14 bp on Monday ahead of the presentation as markets remained confident of the budget, the key elements of which were leaked on Friday.
The 2006 OLO's yield closed flat at 6.23 percent, futures, which spent most of the day in positive territory, ended eight bp lower at 118.21 after a late selloff in thin volume.
